strategy.exit_rule: hold to expiry unless stop hit; force-close by Friday ~3pm ET bar regardless

notes: Real historical Robinhood option prices for 53 SPY weekly $6/$6 iron condors, Jan 2025 - Jan 2026 (entry dates 2025-01-06 through 2026-01-05, expiries through 2026-01-09). Strikes were pre-selected using a Black-Scholes delta approximation against each week's SPY open and prior-week VIX close (short_put_delta_target 0.16, short_call_delta_target 0.21, wing_width 6) per pull_condor_history.py; strikes and settle prices are therefore estimates of where those deltas fell, not exact broker-reported greeks at entry. 'hourly_closes' arrays are hourly last-trade closes from Monday's (or the holiday-shifted entry day's) first bar through expiry-day's last bar. 'entry_prices' are the (short_put, long_put, short_call, long_call) prices at the first hourly bar (~10am ET) on the entry date. 'settle' is SPY's official close on expiry day. All option instrument IDs and hourly historicals were pulled live from Robinhood for expired SPY weekly options; no MISSING legs were encountered (all 53 weeks x 4 legs resolved and priced). 2025-01-20: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-01-21, expiry 2025-01-24 2025-01-20: non-standard week, entry(2025-01-21)->expiry(2025-01-24) = 3 trading days 2025-01-27: prior-week VIX bar (2025-01-20) is interpolated (gap-filled), not a real observed close 2025-02-17: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-02-18, expiry 2025-02-21 2025-02-17: non-standard week, entry(2025-02-18)->expiry(2025-02-21) = 3 trading days 2025-02-24: prior-week VIX bar (2025-02-17) is interpolated (gap-filled), not a real observed close 2025-04-14: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-04-14, expiry 2025-04-17 2025-04-14: non-standard week, entry(2025-04-14)->expiry(2025-04-17) = 3 trading days 2025-05-26: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-05-27, expiry 2025-05-30 2025-05-26: non-standard week, entry(2025-05-27)->expiry(2025-05-30) = 3 trading days 2025-06-02: prior-week VIX bar (2025-05-26) is interpolated (gap-filled), not a real observed close 2025-06-30: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-06-30, expiry 2025-07-03 2025-06-30: non-standard week, entry(2025-06-30)->expiry(2025-07-03) = 3 trading days 2025-09-01: holiday-shifted week -> entry 2025-09-02, expiry 2025-09-05 2025-09-01: non-standard week, entry(2025-09-02)->expiry(2025-09-05) = 3 trading days 2025-09-08: prior-week VIX bar (2025-09-01) is interpolated (gap-filled), not a real observed close 2025-06-30: half trading day ahead of the July 4th holiday (market closed early ~1pm ET on Thu 2025-07-03, the expiry date); hourly_closes for this week has fewer bars than a standard week. 2025-11-24: half trading day the Friday after Thanksgiving (market closed early ~1pm ET on Fri 2025-11-28, the expiry date); hourly_closes for this week has fewer bars than a standard week.
